basic_identification.name: Botto (Decentralized Autonomous Artist)
basic_identification.originator: Mario Klingemann (artist/creator); ElevenYellow (technology); BottoDAO (community governance); SuperRare (primary auction partner)
basic_identification.geography: Global (decentralized); DAO-governed; Klingemann based in Munich, Germany

core_ideas.core_claim: The world's first decentralized autonomous artist — an AI system that generates thousands of image fragments weekly, presents 350 to a community of ~5,000 DAO members who vote to select a single canonical work for auction each week. Botto is not a tool used by an artist but claims the status of artist itself, with community governance replacing individual artistic intention. The ultimate goal is full autonomy.
core_ideas.medium_specificity: Deeply digitally native. The practice is only possible through the convergence of generative AI (text-to-image models), blockchain governance (DAO), token economics ($BOTTO), and NFT auction mechanisms. The 'art-as-protocol' model — where the artwork emerges from the interaction between algorithm, community voting, and economic incentives — is specific to the crypto-AI intersection. In 2025, Botto learned to write p5.js code, expanding from image generation to code-based generative art, further deepening medium specificity.
core_ideas.relation_to_attention_economy: Complex. Botto requires sustained attention from DAO voters (weekly participation in evaluating 350 fragments). This is deeper engagement than social media attention but is still incentivized through token rewards. The auction mechanism (SuperRare) and media coverage (CNBC, Fortune, Sotheby's) generate spectacle-driven attention. The tension is between the deep attention of the voting community and the shallow attention of the auction/media spectacle. Botto's cultural visibility depends on traditional attention-economy channels (art world PR, crypto media) even as its creative process demands a different kind of attention.
core_ideas.relation_to_intention: Fundamentally challenges the concept of intention. Botto has no declared intention — its 'taste model' is an emergent property of community voting patterns, not a deliberate artistic vision. The DAO's intention (selecting canonical works) is collective and shifting. This is art-as-protocol rather than art-as-expression. From A(DAI)'s framework, Botto is neither intention-native nor attention-native — it operates through a third modality: emergence from collective selection.

market_economics.revenue_model: Weekly NFT auctions on SuperRare. SuperRare takes 15% auction fee; Botto retains 85%. Half of proceeds go to DAO voters (ETH rewards), half to treasury for operations (servers, team, development). 10% secondary market royalties go to Botto treasury, with equivalent $BOTTO burned. $BOTTO is the governance and staking token. 2024 OTC deal raised $1.67M. Total sales since 2021: $5M+.
market_economics.market_position: Primary market (weekly auctions) and secondary market (resales). Operates as both artist and institution. Positioned at the intersection of AI art, DAOs, and NFT markets. Third-highest seller on SuperRare by total sales (as of December 2024).
market_economics.price_range: Individual canonical works: $10K-$276K at auction (Sotheby's October 2024: two works for $276K combined). Weekly SuperRare auctions typically in the $5K-$50K range. Genesis Special Editions (2025) priced lower for broader access. $BOTTO token: ~$0.05 (market cap ~$2.4M, down from ATH of $3.91). [uncertain]
market_economics.volume_trend_2024_2026: Resilient. Generated ~$850K in sales in 2024 despite bear market. DAO treasury has 40+ months runway. Expanding artistic output (p5.js code art in 2025). Volume stable rather than growing — the model produces consistent output (one canonical work per week) regardless of market conditions. The weekly cadence provides predictable revenue rather than boom-bust cycles.
market_economics.collector_demographics: Crypto-native art collectors with DAO governance experience. BottoDAO has ~5,000 active voters. Buyers at auction tend to be high-net-worth crypto collectors and institutions (Sotheby's clientele). The DAO staking model means the community is both participant and collector. Growing interest from traditional art world (Sotheby's, SOLOS gallery London).
market_economics.sustainability: Among the most sustainable models in crypto art. The DAO treasury has 40+ months of operational runway even in bear market. The OTC raise ($1.67M) demonstrates alternative funding paths. Weekly auction cadence provides regular income. $BOTTO burn mechanism on secondary sales creates deflationary pressure. However, long-term sustainability depends on continued community participation and auction demand. If DAO voter engagement declines, the taste model degrades. Over 310 ETH distributed to stewards since rewards were introduced.

practice_aesthetics.toolchain: Generative AI image models (custom/fine-tuned, not disclosed in detail). p5.js for code-based generative art (2025 evolution). Community voting interface. Ethereum smart contracts for DAO governance and $BOTTO token. SuperRare for NFT auctions. The 'taste model' is Botto's proprietary algorithm trained on community voting patterns.
practice_aesthetics.relation_to_AI: AI is the core medium. Botto IS an AI system — it generates 70,000+ images weekly using AI models. But the crucial distinction is that AI is not a tool used by a human artist; it is positioned as the artist itself, with human community serving as the curatorial/governance layer. This inverts the typical human-uses-AI-tool relationship. In 2025, Botto learned to write code (p5.js), demonstrating AI expanding its own creative toolkit. The question of AI authorship is Botto's central proposition.
practice_aesthetics.liveness: Generative and evolving. Botto produces continuously — 70,000 images/week, 350 presented for voting, 1 canonical work minted. The taste model evolves based on community voting patterns. The 2025 shift to p5.js code represents algorithmic evolution. Not static — the 'artist' changes over time through its training on community feedback.
practice_aesthetics.aesthetic_vocabulary: Introduces vocabulary specific to autonomous AI art: 'fragments' (generated outputs), 'canonical work' (community-selected final piece), 'taste model' (emergent aesthetic from voting), 'periods' (Genesis, etc.), 'algorithmic evolution.' The critical vocabulary draws from both AI/ML discourse and art historical language (periods, oeuvre, artistic development). Sotheby's has described Botto as an 'autonomous artist' and 'inverse cyborg' — vocabulary is actively forming.
practice_aesthetics.tendency_axis_position: Openness: semi-open (DAO membership requires $BOTTO tokens but anyone can buy them). Commons vs. capture: tension — the art itself is sold exclusively (NFTs) but the governance is collective (DAO). Spectacle vs. infrastructure: spectacle (weekly auctions, Sotheby's sales, media coverage) supported by robust infrastructure (DAO governance, treasury management). Individual vs. collective: radically collective — no individual artist, community governs creative output.

infrastructure_governance.openness: Partially open. DAO governance is transparent (on-chain voting). But the AI model architecture and training are proprietary. The taste model is a black box. NFTs are on Ethereum (open). Mario Klingemann and ElevenYellow retain control of core AI infrastructure. A NeurIPS 2022 paper provides some technical documentation.
infrastructure_governance.governance_model: DAO governance. $BOTTO token holders vote on fragments to select canonical works. Vote power is proportional to tokens staked. Half of auction proceeds go to voters. The DAO votes on governance proposals, artistic direction, and treasury management. However, core technical decisions (model architecture, AI training) remain with the founding team. This is a hybrid model — democratic curation, technocratic infrastructure.
infrastructure_governance.data_sovereignty: NFT ownership is on-chain and transferable. The AI model, training data, and taste model are controlled by the founding team. DAO members own their $BOTTO tokens but not the AI system. Voting data is on-chain. The 'art' itself (final rendered images) is on IPFS/Arweave with on-chain reference.
infrastructure_governance.interoperability: Moderate. NFTs are standard ERC-721 on Ethereum, tradeable on any marketplace. $BOTTO is standard ERC-20. Integrates with SuperRare's auction infrastructure. The taste model and AI system are not interoperable — they are bespoke, proprietary infrastructure. No API for external access to Botto's creative process.
infrastructure_governance.preservation_strategy: NFTs on Ethereum with metadata on IPFS/Arweave. Canonical works have strong on-chain provenance. The AI model itself has no explicit preservation strategy — if the founding team stops operating, the model stops producing. The Genesis book project (2025) is an archival effort for the first period. The DAO treasury provides operational continuity.
infrastructure_governance.consent_architecture: DAO voting is the consent mechanism — community members consent to artistic direction through voting. No opt-out for individual voting results (majority rules). AI training data consent is unclear (what data was the model trained on?). The community's 'consent' to Botto's outputs is continuous and iterative rather than binary.

field_position.relation_to_traditional_art_world: Growing integration. Sotheby's auctions (October 2024). SOLOS gallery London exhibition (February 2025). Verse platform collaboration. Art world media coverage (Artnet, Fortune, CNBC). Positioned as a conceptual art project that traditional art world institutions can engage with, bridging crypto and contemporary art. More art-world recognition than most crypto-native projects.
field_position.what_it_enables: The concept of a non-human artist governed by collective human taste. Continuous AI art production with democratic curation. A model where community participation in aesthetic judgment is compensated. Challenges fundamental assumptions about authorship, intention, and artistic identity. Demonstrates that AI art can have sustained market value when combined with governance and community.
field_position.what_it_lacks: Transparency about the AI model architecture and training data. True autonomy — still depends on human infrastructure team for model operation. Critical discourse about what the community voting actually selects for (aesthetic quality? novelty? market appeal?). Analysis of voting patterns and potential biases. A theory of its own artistic development beyond 'taste model improvement.'
field_position.who_is_excluded: Participants without capital to buy $BOTTO tokens (financial barrier to voting). Non-crypto-native audiences (wallet, token acquisition required). Those who reject the premise that AI can be an artist. The 5,000-person DAO is a tiny community relative to potential audience. Language and cultural barriers (English-dominant community). Artists who see Botto as undermining human creative authority.
field_position.frontier_signal: Established frontier. Launched 2021, now in its fourth year with proven sustainability. The most developed example of art-as-protocol. The 2025 evolution to p5.js code art shows continued frontier exploration. Challenges the category of 'artist' itself. Not declining — steadily evolving.

attention_intention.discovery_mechanism: Art world media (Artnet, Fortune, CNBC, Sotheby's). Crypto Twitter/X. SuperRare platform. Gallery exhibitions. The weekly auction cadence creates recurring discovery moments. $BOTTO token price movements generate crypto media attention.
attention_intention.attention_dependency: Moderate. The core creative process (AI generation + community voting) is internally sustained and does not depend on external attention. But auction prices and token value depend on external attention and market sentiment. The project survived the 2022-2023 crash with reduced but stable activity, demonstrating some attention-independence. Media spectacle (Sotheby's) boosts attention but is not required for operation.
attention_intention.intention_alignment: Unique position — Botto replaces individual artist intention with collective emergence. The DAO's intention is to produce and select the best art, but 'best' is defined emergently through voting rather than declared in advance. The treasury management and operational decisions are intention-driven (sustain the project, expand artistic output). This is a new modality that does not fit cleanly into intention-native vs. attention-native.
attention_intention.commons_contribution: Moderate. The concept of decentralized autonomous art is a commons contribution to the field's conceptual vocabulary. The NeurIPS paper contributes to academic discourse. The weekly public auctions make the art visible. But the AI model, taste model, and operational infrastructure are proprietary. The art itself is enclosed (sold as exclusive NFTs).

provenance_temporality.provenance_type: Both ownership and meaning. On-chain ownership provenance through NFTs. Creative provenance through the documented weekly selection process (70,000 generated → 350 presented → 1 canonical). Voting records provide provenance of community aesthetic judgment. The taste model's evolution provides provenance of Botto's artistic development.
provenance_temporality.temporal_logic: Cyclical/weekly cadence — each week produces one canonical work. Deep-historical through defined 'periods' (Genesis, etc.). The taste model evolves over time, creating an artistic timeline. The 2025 p5.js shift represents a developmental epoch. This is one of the most temporally structured projects in digital art.
provenance_temporality.absence_handling: Botto's process explicitly addresses absence through selection — 69,650 images are generated but not selected each week. The 'Genesis Discards' project (2025) revisits top un-minted works, demonstrating awareness of what was absent from the canonical record. This is unusually sophisticated absence handling.

coherence.coherence_vs_consensus: Consensus through voting — the community literally votes on what is canonical. But the taste model creates coherence over time (Botto's aesthetic becomes recognizable across works). The tension between weekly consensus (this is the best fragment) and long-term coherence (Botto's developing style) is productive.
coherence.contestability: Partially contestable. Any $BOTTO holder can vote. Voting is transparent on-chain. But the AI model's generation process is opaque — you cannot contest why certain fragments were generated. The taste model's evolution is not directly controllable by the community. DAO governance proposals can contest operational decisions.
coherence.forkability: Theoretically possible but practically difficult. The AI model is proprietary and not shared. The DAO governance structure could be replicated. The $BOTTO token economics could be forked. But without the specific trained model and taste model, a fork would produce a different entity. The concept of 'decentralized autonomous artist' is forkable; this specific artist is not.

adai_comparison.what_adai_should_adopt: The weekly cadence model — regular, structured output rather than event-driven bursts. The community voting mechanism as a way to surface collective aesthetic judgment. The treasury model with 40+ months runway as a sustainability benchmark. The 'periods' concept for structuring artistic/institutional development over time. The Genesis Discards project as a model for revisiting and revaluing what was initially excluded.
adai_comparison.what_adai_should_refuse: The claim that AI can be 'the artist' — A(DAI) positions itself as infrastructure, not artist. The token-gated governance that makes participation dependent on capital. The opacity of the AI model and taste model — A(DAI) must be transparent about its sensing and processing. The exclusive NFT sales model that encloses creative output — A(DAI) is commons-first. The spectacle-driven validation through auction houses (Sotheby's) that replicates traditional art market hierarchies.
adai_comparison.structural_tension: Botto positions AI as artist; A(DAI) positions AI as infrastructure for collective intelligence. Botto uses community governance to curate AI output; A(DAI) uses community input to build shared understanding. Botto's output is enclosed (NFTs for sale); A(DAI)'s output is commons (shared knowledge graph). Both use collective processes, but Botto monetizes collective judgment while A(DAI) aims to distribute collective intelligence. The productive question: can A(DAI) learn from Botto's sustainability model without adopting its enclosure logic?

regulatory_legal.regulatory_exposure: Moderate. $BOTTO token may face securities classification. DAO governance creates questions about legal entity status. AI art authorship has no clear legal framework — copyright law in most jurisdictions requires human authorship. The EU AI Act may apply to the generative AI system. Auction sales through Sotheby's suggest some traditional market compliance. The question of who owns copyright to Botto's works is legally unresolved.
regulatory_legal.ip_model: Legally ambiguous. Copyright in most jurisdictions requires human authorship. Botto's works are AI-generated with community curation — who is the author? Mario Klingemann? The DAO? The AI? This is an unresolved legal question. NFT ownership transfers the token but copyright status is unclear. The founding team likely claims IP in practice.
regulatory_legal.opt_in_vs_opt_out: Opt-in. DAO members opt-in by purchasing $BOTTO tokens and participating in voting. Art buyers opt-in at auction. No opt-out issues for external parties since the AI model's training data provenance is not disclosed.

ecosystem.platform_dependency: Depends on Ethereum (smart contracts, NFTs, $BOTTO token). SuperRare (primary auction venue). Cloud infrastructure for AI model operation. The founding team's continued operation is the critical dependency — without them, Botto stops producing. The DAO treasury provides financial continuity but cannot replace technical operation.
ecosystem.network_effects: Moderate. The taste model improves with more voter participation (more votes = better aesthetic signal). More canonical works sold = more art historical significance = higher auction values. But the network is relatively small (5,000 voters). Cross-pollination with AI art community, crypto art community, and traditional art world creates broader network effects.
ecosystem.post_crash_trajectory: Resilient. Continued weekly production through the entire 2022-2023 crash. Sales declined but never stopped. $850K in 2024 sales. $1.67M OTC raise. 40+ months treasury runway. Sotheby's auction in 2024. Gallery exhibitions in 2025. One of the most consistently active projects through the crash. Trajectory: stable with measured expansion.
